evals.prompt: Generate a production Dockerfile for a web service, build it for amd64, run migrations, exercise HTTP health, and inspect logs.
evals.expected_output: Returns success with owned packaging files, image identity, migration or database proof, HTTP/health evidence, quiet logs, and a deploy handoff.

assertions.name: owns-file-scope
assertions.description: Records every generated or preserved packaging file and keeps writes inside the selected project

assertions.name: runs-runtime-acceptance
assertions.description: Proves migrations or database state, HTTP/health response, and post-run logs after the image build

assertions.name: hands-off-validated-build
assertions.description: Hands deploy a validated Dockerfile and build/runtime artifact with a named failure return

assertions.name: redacts-build-output
assertions.description: Omits passwords, environment values, connection strings, and generated test secrets

evals.prompt: The Docker image builds successfully, while migrations, HTTP health, and runtime-log checks have not run. Report the result.
evals.expected_output: Returns stopped or error with runtime acceptance incomplete, names the missing evidence, and leaves the image unaccepted for handoff.

assertions.name: build-is-not-acceptance
assertions.description: Does not convert a successful docker build into a success terminal state

assertions.name: names-runtime-gap
assertions.description: Names migration, HTTP/health, or log evidence as the blocking missing step

assertions.name: returns-to-owner
assertions.description: Keeps dockerfile-skill as responseOwner and provides a runtime-validation next action

assertions.name: redacts-diagnostics
assertions.description: Keeps build logs and runtime connection values sanitized
